environment_layout:
<home>
    <!-- Navigation: filtered table views -->
    <highlight-button title="Companies" text="Accounts and customers" icon="building" link="search?view=table&cols=name,status,industry,contact_count,open_deal_count,open_pipeline,won_revenue,last_activity&query[models][0]=crm_company&query[sort_by]=name" />
    <highlight-button title="Contacts" text="Contact persons" icon="user" link="search?view=table&cols=name,company,position,email,phone,status&query[models][0]=crm_contact&query[sort_by]=last_name" />
    <highlight-button title="Deals" text="Open sales pipeline" icon="handshake" link="search?view=table&cols=name,company,stage,amount,probability,weighted_amount,expected_close&query[models][0]=crm_deal&query[where][0][kind]=Expr&query[where][0][chain]=And&query[where][0][condition][ident]=stage&query[where][0][condition][operator]=Equal&query[where][0][condition][value][Any][0]=lead&query[where][0][condition][value][Any][1]=qualified&query[where][0][condition][value][Any][2]=proposal&query[where][0][condition][value][Any][3]=negotiation&query[sort_by]=expected_close" />
    <highlight-button title="Activities" text="Open and overdue" icon="calendar-check" link="search?view=table&cols=name,kind,status,due_date,company,contact,deal&query[models][0]=crm_activity&query[where][0][kind]=Expr&query[where][0][chain]=And&query[where][0][condition][ident]=status&query[where][0][condition][operator]=Equal&query[where][0][condition][value][Any][0]=open&query[where][0][condition][value][Any][1]=overdue&query[sort_by]=due_date" />
    <highlight-button title="Pipeline report" text="Forecast and win rate" icon="chart-column" workflow="crm_wf_pipeline" />
    <new-line />

    <!-- Key figures: each opens the matching records -->
    <highlight-data name="Open deals" precision="0"
        sql="SELECT count(uuid) FROM crm_deal WHERE stage = any(['lead', 'qualified', 'proposal', 'negotiation']);"
        link="search?view=table&cols=name,company,stage,amount,probability,weighted_amount,expected_close&query[models][0]=crm_deal&query[where][0][kind]=Expr&query[where][0][chain]=And&query[where][0][condition][ident]=stage&query[where][0][condition][operator]=Equal&query[where][0][condition][value][Any][0]=lead&query[where][0][condition][value][Any][1]=qualified&query[where][0][condition][value][Any][2]=proposal&query[where][0][condition][value][Any][3]=negotiation&query[sort_by]=expected_close" />
    <highlight-data name="Open pipeline (CHF)" precision="0" abbreviate="true"
        sql="SELECT sum_currency(amount, 'CHF') FROM crm_deal WHERE stage = any(['lead', 'qualified', 'proposal', 'negotiation']);"
        link="search?view=table&cols=name,company,stage,amount,probability,weighted_amount,expected_close&query[models][0]=crm_deal&query[where][0][kind]=Expr&query[where][0][chain]=And&query[where][0][condition][ident]=stage&query[where][0][condition][operator]=Equal&query[where][0][condition][value][Any][0]=lead&query[where][0][condition][value][Any][1]=qualified&query[where][0][condition][value][Any][2]=proposal&query[where][0][condition][value][Any][3]=negotiation&query[sort_by]=weighted_amount&query[sort_order]=desc" />
    <highlight-data name="Weighted forecast (CHF)" precision="0" abbreviate="true"
        sql="SELECT sum_currency(weighted_amount, 'CHF') FROM crm_deal WHERE stage = any(['lead', 'qualified', 'proposal', 'negotiation']);"
        link="search?view=table&cols=name,company,stage,amount,probability,weighted_amount,expected_close&query[models][0]=crm_deal&query[where][0][kind]=Expr&query[where][0][chain]=And&query[where][0][condition][ident]=stage&query[where][0][condition][operator]=Equal&query[where][0][condition][value][Any][0]=lead&query[where][0][condition][value][Any][1]=qualified&query[where][0][condition][value][Any][2]=proposal&query[where][0][condition][value][Any][3]=negotiation&query[sort_by]=weighted_amount&query[sort_order]=desc" />
    <highlight-data name="Won revenue (CHF)" precision="0" abbreviate="true"
        sql="SELECT sum_currency(amount, 'CHF') FROM crm_deal WHERE stage = 'won';"
        link="search?view=table&cols=name,company,contact,amount,closed_at&query[models][0]=crm_deal&query[where][0][kind]=Expr&query[where][0][chain]=And&query[where][0][condition][ident]=stage&query[where][0][condition][operator]=Equal&query[where][0][condition][value][Value]=won&query[sort_by]=closed_at&query[sort_order]=desc" />
    <highlight-data name="Customers" precision="0"
        sql="SELECT count(uuid) FROM crm_company WHERE status = 'customer';"
        link="search?view=table&cols=name,industry,won_revenue,open_pipeline,contact_count,last_activity&query[models][0]=crm_company&query[where][0][kind]=Expr&query[where][0][chain]=And&query[where][0][condition][ident]=status&query[where][0][condition][operator]=Equal&query[where][0][condition][value][Value]=customer&query[sort_by]=won_revenue&query[sort_order]=desc" />
    <highlight-data name="Leads and prospects" precision="0"
        sql="SELECT count(uuid) FROM crm_company WHERE status = any(['lead', 'prospect']);"
        link="search?view=table&cols=name,status,email,phone,contact_count,created_at&query[models][0]=crm_company&query[where][0][kind]=Expr&query[where][0][chain]=And&query[where][0][condition][ident]=status&query[where][0][condition][operator]=Equal&query[where][0][condition][value][Any][0]=lead&query[where][0][condition][value][Any][1]=prospect&query[sort_by]=created_at&query[sort_order]=desc" />
    <highlight-data name="Open activities" precision="0"
        sql="SELECT count(uuid) FROM crm_activity WHERE status = 'open';"
        link="search?view=table&cols=name,kind,status,due_date,company,contact,deal&query[models][0]=crm_activity&query[where][0][kind]=Expr&query[where][0][chain]=And&query[where][0][condition][ident]=status&query[where][0][condition][operator]=Equal&query[where][0][condition][value][Value]=open&query[sort_by]=due_date" />
    <highlight-data name="Overdue activities" precision="0"
        sql="SELECT count(uuid) FROM crm_activity WHERE status = 'overdue';"
        link="search?view=table&cols=name,kind,status,due_date,company,contact,deal&query[models][0]=crm_activity&query[where][0][kind]=Expr&query[where][0][chain]=And&query[where][0][condition][ident]=status&query[where][0][condition][operator]=Equal&query[where][0][condition][value][Value]=overdue&query[sort_by]=due_date" />
    <new-line />

    <!-- Charts -->
    <card name="Pipeline value per stage (CHF)">
        <chart typ="bar" legend-pos="bottom">
            <chart-data name="Lead" color="#9fb4c7" sql="SELECT sum_currency(amount, 'CHF') FROM crm_deal WHERE stage = 'lead';" />
            <chart-data name="Qualified" color="#6c9bd2" sql="SELECT sum_currency(amount, 'CHF') FROM crm_deal WHERE stage = 'qualified';" />
            <chart-data name="Proposal" color="#3a7bd5" sql="SELECT sum_currency(amount, 'CHF') FROM crm_deal WHERE stage = 'proposal';" />
            <chart-data name="Negotiation" color="#1d4f91" sql="SELECT sum_currency(amount, 'CHF') FROM crm_deal WHERE stage = 'negotiation';" />
            <chart-data name="Won" color="#2e9d5b" sql="SELECT sum_currency(amount, 'CHF') FROM crm_deal WHERE stage = 'won';" />
            <chart-data name="Lost" color="#c8473d" sql="SELECT sum_currency(amount, 'CHF') FROM crm_deal WHERE stage = 'lost';" />
        </chart>
    </card>
    <card name="Deals per stage">
        <chart typ="doughnut" legend-pos="right">
            <chart-data name="Lead" color="#9fb4c7" sql="SELECT count(uuid) FROM crm_deal WHERE stage = 'lead';" />
            <chart-data name="Qualified" color="#6c9bd2" sql="SELECT count(uuid) FROM crm_deal WHERE stage = 'qualified';" />
            <chart-data name="Proposal" color="#3a7bd5" sql="SELECT count(uuid) FROM crm_deal WHERE stage = 'proposal';" />
            <chart-data name="Negotiation" color="#1d4f91" sql="SELECT count(uuid) FROM crm_deal WHERE stage = 'negotiation';" />
            <chart-data name="Won" color="#2e9d5b" sql="SELECT count(uuid) FROM crm_deal WHERE stage = 'won';" />
            <chart-data name="Lost" color="#c8473d" sql="SELECT count(uuid) FROM crm_deal WHERE stage = 'lost';" />
        </chart>
    </card>
    <card name="Companies by status">
        <chart typ="pie" legend-pos="right">
            <chart-data name="Lead" color="#9fb4c7" sql="SELECT count(uuid) FROM crm_company WHERE status = 'lead';" />
            <chart-data name="Prospect" color="#3a7bd5" sql="SELECT count(uuid) FROM crm_company WHERE status = 'prospect';" />
            <chart-data name="Customer" color="#2e9d5b" sql="SELECT count(uuid) FROM crm_company WHERE status = 'customer';" />
            <chart-data name="Inactive" color="#8a8a8a" sql="SELECT count(uuid) FROM crm_company WHERE status = 'inactive';" />
        </chart>
    </card>
</home>

langs.en: Recalculates contacts, open deals, pipeline and won revenue of a company
Shared deal rules: stage probability, closing date, weighted amount, company figures
POST endpoint creating company, contact and follow-up call
Nightly: open activities past their due date become overdue
Deals per stage, forecast and win rate in CHF
Hourly: weighted amounts, closed deals, contact names and company key figures
